comment: Sharded validation (docs/contributing/ci.md). shards: CI jobs per suite; each shard runs its files with the options of the suite's npm script, and compat:report --from-shards requires every planned shard. profile: the tools/ci/test-durations.json profile that balances them. fastLane: the affected-test selection of wave2/** pushes (tools/ci/affected.mjs); bases are the remote branches whose nearest merge base with HEAD is the branch point, except notBases (integration branches, downstream of the branches they merge) and branches that already contain HEAD.
